content.text:
## Notes on unclear/wrong instructions

- The plan header syntax is never fully specified: `body=`, `anchor=`, `lines=` must sit on the `@@` header line itself, not on a following line. Putting `body=1` on its own line isn't rejected — it silently becomes literal file content (an extra line was written), which contradicts "a plan that fails validation writes nothing" since this wasn't a validation failure at all, just silent misinterpretation. I had to revert and redo the edit twice.
- No `--after N` vs `--before N` control exists, only symmetric `-C N`/`--context`, so "TODO plus one line after" (task 4) can't be requested precisely — I used `-C 1` and discarded the leading context line manually.
- The `-2` ("from the start") write-plan refusal doesn't give the clean "unsupported form" error the docs imply; it fails earlier as a generic parse error (`bad line number ""`), exit 2, which reads like an unrelated bug rather than a documented restriction.
